sources.name: ACE-FTS solar atlas

sources.name: NSO Kitt Peak IR photosphere atlas (photatl)
sources.citation: Livingston & Wallace 1991, "An Atlas of the Solar Spectrum in the Infrared from 1850 to 9000 cm⁻¹ (1.1 to 5.4 µm)", NSO Tech. Report #91-001. Acknowledgement: "NSO/Kitt Peak FTS data used here were produced by NSF/NOAO."

sources.telluric_status: TERRESTRIAL (disk-center): col solar=telluric-corrected, col atmospheric=residual telluric, col total=observed. NB gaps in strong-telluric regions are LINEAR INTERPOLATIONS (README); intensities not continuous file-to-file.

sources.name: Wallace Telluric Near-IR Atlas

sources.citation: Wallace, Hinkle & Livingston, "The Absorption Spectrum of the Earth's Atmosphere from 0.578 to 5.43 µm (1800 to 17400 cm⁻¹)", NOAO/NSO. Telluric = ratio of 5-airmass / 2-airmass FTS scans (1990/12/18 #4 & #5, center disc) → solar cancels.
sources.COVERAGE_CAVEAT: the ASCII telluric ratio (ratio04300.txt) spans only 4299.8–4338.6 cm⁻¹ — the MIDDLE of the 4255–4367 CO band.
